questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville gerne til et engelsktalende land.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var meget let. De er super søde til at hjælpe i deres Exchange Office, hvor man både kan skrive mails, ringe og dukke op.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: De havde et exchange student event i starten, hvor man kunne møde alle de andre.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Simon Fraser University er meget velkomne mod deres udvekslingsstuderende, da vi heller ikke er så mange igen. Jeg tror vi var 200 udvekslingsstuderende ialt.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Der er dorm rooms og små townhouses. Jeg boede i Twonhouses, hvilket er en lejlighed, hvor man bor 4 sammen.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: I townhouses havde vi alt ligesom i en normal lejlighed, så eget køkken. Der er en dinning hall, som de fleste der boede i dorm rooms var tilknyttet, hvor de kunne få mad. Den var dog ret dyr, så jeg endte med at købe et dinning hall pas, så jeg kunne spise derinde med de andre engang i mellem

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Stort set alle udvekslingsstuderende boede på campus, hvilket var super hyggeligt, da vi alle stødte ind i hinanden og kunne hænge ud og lave mad sammen osv. Jeg synes helt klar townhouses var fedeste, da det var mest socialt. Jeg boede sammen med nogen canadiere, hvilket var super hyggeligt. Nogen af de andre var dog ikke så heldige med deres roomies i townhouses.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Man skal selv købe alt til køkkenet, hvis man bor i townhouse. Jeg var så heldig at bo med nogen der havde det hele med, så jeg ikke behøvede ud og finde pander og gryder.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Det var meget simplet, der var dog deadlines man skulle holde øje med i forhold til at tilmelde sig kurser og være sikker på, at de var godkendt af KU. så vær i god tid.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Jeg snakkede meget med deres exchange office, da jeg skulle ordne kurser, og de var super søde til at hjælpe med det hele.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Nogen af mine oprindelige kurser var på et andet campus, så jeg endte med at skifte dem ud, da jeg ikke gad med offentligt et andet sted hen. Ellers fik jeg alle de kurser jeg gerne ville have og deres exchange office tilmeldte mig mine fag.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Husk deadlines

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det kommer meget an på, hvilket professor man får. Jeg havde en enkelt der var virkelig dårlig, men alle de andre var virkelig gode.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: jeg havde både 1., 2., og 3. års fag og overordnet synes jeg niveauet var lidt lavere end på KU. Deres struktur er dog meget anderledes end på KU og minder lidt mere om gym, da man har mange flere små opgaver i løbet af semesteret. Der er mange ting der derfor tæller med i ens endelige karakter og ikke kun ens final exam. Det er heller ikke alle fag der har final exams.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: de har lectures, som er fuldstænding ligesom forelæsninger derhjemme og så har de nogen gange tutorials/labs tilknyttet, hvor man laver små opgaver. Der er derudover seminars, som er lidt en blanding af de to.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
GSWS 100 sex talk
CRIM 104 sociological explanations to deviant behaviour
GSWS 205 gender and popular culture
GSWS 312 Women, Migration and transnational immigration

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg kunne virkelig godt lide mit kvinder og migration fag (GSWS312). Der udover synes jeg mit fag i kriminologi var virkelig spændende.

questions.answer:

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der er både svømmehal og fitness center som er gratis på campus. Derudover har de mange forskellige klubber man kan tilmelde sig bl.a. en skiklub og en vandreklub som begge laver små endagsture.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Vi lavede ofte selv ture (udvekslingsstuderende) og alle var meget åbne for at lave og tage på ture hver weekend

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Vi tog på vandreture hver weekend, da vi var virkelig heldige med vejret. Derudover lavede vi ture til Vancouver Island, Seattle og længere vandreture, hvor vi overnattede i telt. Vejret vendte ret hurtigt og da vi ikke længere kunne vandre, kunne vi tage ud og stå på ski.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: ja, Vancouver er en meget international by og alle er meget velkomne.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Duk op til de ting og begivenheder der er.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: man skal betale tips (15-20%).

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Folk er meget åbne

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Vær åben. Bo på campus så du kan møde og hænge ud med alle de andre. Universitet ligger på toppen af et bjerg og solnedgangene er derfor også helt fantastisk flotte.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: man finder hurtigt ud af det hele.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Lærte en masse nye at kende. Synes det var virkelig fedt at bo i udlandet.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Jeg var virkelig overrasket over, hvor mange hjemløse der var i downtown.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
